name: CSS Guardian
note: R13.29A, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.69 (PDF p.70) — the SAME SHEET as the FFE, which draws one hull diagram and gives it two ship data tables. Every box is the FFE's and was counted once, there: shields 16 all round, crew 16, boarding parties 6, deck crews 2, excess 3, warp 6 a side, one aux, one APR, two plasma-D racks. ONLY THREE THINGS DIFFER, and they are the whole reason this is a separate file rather than a refit of the FFE: service year 175 rather than 170, point value 77 rather than 67, and FULL aegis rather than the limited aegis the FFE's Y175 refit grants. The sheet says so in as many words — 'INCLUDES Y175 REFIT' and 'INCLUDES FULL AEGIS' — so the Y175 refit is baked in here and must NOT also be offered: a buyer would otherwise pay for it twice. Modelled as its own hull because R13.29A is its own reference with its own point value, which is how this project reads a lettered sub-reference. The Y180 Sabot refit (+2.5) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope, and the half point will not fit an integer bpv.
